Dad: Was your stand made from plastic?
Eva: No, it was made from used boxes.
Dad: Did you cut the shapes?
Eva: Our teacher cut them. We added color and tested the design.
Dad: What was wrong at first?
Eva: The stand was too low. Jo suggested a new shape.
Dad: Were the instructions printed?
Eva: Yes, with photos taken by Sam.
Dad: Did the visitors understand them?
Eva: Yes. They liked the clear pictures.
Dad: What are you most pleased about?
Eva: We used something we already had to solve a real problem.
